prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.415 °C/min (5% above healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.2 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure rise time 9.39 s (within 1% of healthy); PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.87 s (within 1% of healthy). Sharp pressure transient and immediate switching between sensors indicate optimal valve response.
Pump leakage: no leakage. Evidence: EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 380 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); FS1 mean volume flow 6.71 l/min (2% above healthy). Pump delivers nominal flow rate at baseline electrical input power.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.2 bar (within 1% of healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
